CommunityApplications.Profile:
Unraid Community Applications template for **Fluxo**, a personal finance / household budgeting app (ASP.NET Core backend with a built-in React frontend). Runs as a single Docker container and needs an external PostgreSQL database.
This repository only contains the Unraid template metadata (MIT-licensed) — the Fluxo application itself is closed-source and published as a container image only, at ghcr.io/synshiftlabs/fluxo.
Support: open an issue in this repository.
